subject: BCP evidence: restore playbook & RTO/RPO traceability
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasPay Compliance Team <compliance@atlaspay.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 15:05:00 -0400
Subject: BCP evidence request — restore traceability and RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the overview last week. As part of AtlasPay's SIG review we're trying to close the loop on a few BCP / DR items before our final sign-off:

1) Can you provide an auditable trace that ties a recent restore exercise to the RTO/RPO claims in your SOC2/Metrics pack? Specifically we want timestamps (start/end), playbook/reference id, and the artifact that proves recovery succeeded (checksums, load-test traces).

2) During your demo you mentioned a "warm-KV snapshot" approach. Can you confirm the warm-cache priming time for our US region and attach the operation logs or a short trace?

3) Any tabletop or recorded witness material (video timestamps or runbook execution notes) that shows roles and time-to-recovery would be very helpful.

We tried to reconcile the figures in the SOC2 appendix with the RTO/RPO table in your customer handbook and there are a couple of gaps. Can your team deliver the requested artifacts by EOD Tuesday (25 Aug)? If not, please propose the earliest firm drop.

Appreciate it — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
AtlasPay

[Attachment: internal_guidance_SIG-checklist.pdf (referenced)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 15:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BCP evidence request — restore traceability and RTO/RPO artifacts

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can provide everything you asked for. Below is our proposed package and delivery plan.

Package contents (what we'll deliver):
- rto_rpo_trace_log-20270820.csv — step-level timestamps from the restore run (start, each stage, end) with outcome codes and checksums.
- restore-playbook-v2.pdf — canonical runbook used in the exercise (playbook id: RPB-2027-07-03-v2).
- tabletop-video-timestamps.txt — short notes + clip timestamps for the witness recording (we'll provide the recording link).
- runbook-execution-checksums.txt — MD5 checksums for the extracted volumes used during validation.

Clarifications / notes:
- The exercise on 2027-08-20 was a simulated instance failover + cold restore of a small shard to validate our automated restore script. Full production warm-failover SLOs are captured in the dedicated RPO/RTO dashboard (we'll include a slice for your account).
- For the KV cache: warm-priming to reach 95% hit-rate in us-east-1 was 5m 20s in that run (see trace). That number varies by workload; we will include the histogram and the command we run to pre-seed cache snapshots.
- Attachments will be uploaded to a shared Drive folder and to HubSpot (per your preference). We will redact internal hostnames and keep only runbook IDs, timings, and checksums for auditability.

Delivery timeline: we can drop an initial package by Mon 2027-08-23 10:00 AM ET and a follow-up with the recording + dashboard slice by Tue 2027-08-25 5:00 PM ET. Does that meet your needs?

If you'd like a short witness call to walk the artifacts we can schedule 30 minutes Mon afternoon.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Security Response
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: restore-playbook-v2.pdf, rto_rpo_trace_log-20270820.csv]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasPay Compliance Team <compliance@atlaspay.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BCP evidence request — restore traceability and RTO/RPO artifacts

Thanks Mina — that timeline works for us. Two quick asks before your drop:

- For audit purposes we need the runbook id in the PDF to match the id in the trace CSV exactly (no manual edits after generation). Please ensure the CSV contains the RPB-2027-07-03-v2 identifier in the header.
- Can you also flag whether the restore run included any fallbacks to secondary regions (and if so, include a short note on the routing decision and timestamps).

We'll plan for the witness call Tue 2027-08-24 11:00 AM ET unless you propose otherwise. If you can share the Drive link after the first drop we'll start internal review immediately.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elena

On Sun, Aug 22, 2027 at 3:35 PM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can provide everything you asked for...

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 17:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BCP evidence request — restore traceability and RTO/RPO artifacts

Elena — delivered the initial package to the shared Drive (link below) and attached the three primary artifacts to this thread for quick download. Highlights:

- rto_rpo_trace_log-20270820.csv (header includes playbook id: RPB-2027-07-03-v2; start=2027-08-20T02:14:54Z; end=2027-08-20T02:35:12Z; total wall-clock=00:20:18)
- restore-playbook-v2.pdf (RPB-2027-07-03-v2; section 4.2 lists step numbers matching CSV stage ids)
- tabletop-video-timestamps.txt (clip markers for witness: 00:01:12 cluster fail detected; 00:03:44 restore initiated; 00:12:05 validation checks passed)

Notes on regional fallback: this particular exercise did not require fallback to us-west-2; the routing policy attempted primary recover in us-east-1 and succeeded. There is a single log line in the CSV indicating a transient route check to secondary but no failover. We'll flag that line with note "route_check_secondary=no-failover" for audit clarity.

Shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/BCP-ATL-1092
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/ATL-1092

If you'd like, Karthik can run through the CSV fields on the witness call Tuesday. Proposed time remains Tue 2027-08-24 11:00 AM ET.

Best,
Mina

Attachments: rto_rpo_trace_log-20270820.csv (attachment), restore-playbook-v2.pdf (attachment), tabletop-video-timestamps.txt (attachment)
